name: The Restaurant
tagline: Coastal comfort food with a neighborhood feel.
description: Casual full-service dining with seasonal menus, local produce where possible, and a curated wine and mocktail list. Family-friendly; high chairs available.
accessibility: Wheelchair-accessible entrance and restrooms; please note one small step at the patio.
parking: Street parking and a 12-space lot behind the building (entrance on Coral Lane).
policies: Reservations held 15 minutes. Split checks up to 4 ways. Corkage $20 per 750ml (2 bottle max). Outside desserts allowed for celebrations with $15 plating fee. Gratuity may be added for parties of 8 or more.
